meaning.en: Crying out with hunger, waiting to be fed; describes starving people or dependants in desperate need.
meaning.zh: 饥饿时哀叫着等待喂食，形容挨饿的悲惨情景，也比喻急需帮助。

examples.zh: 家里还有三个嗷嗷待哺的孩子。
examples.en: There are still three hungry mouths to feed at home.

examples.zh: 灾区群众嗷嗷待哺，急需救援物资。
examples.en: People in the disaster zone are starving and urgently need relief supplies.

examples.zh: 这些初创企业嗷嗷待哺，盼着投资到位。
examples.en: These start-ups are desperate for the investment to come through.

meaning.en: To smash one's cooking pot and sell it for scrap; to give everything one has for a cause.
meaning.zh: 把锅砸了当废铁卖，比喻拿出全部家当，不惜一切代价。

equivalents: sell the shirt off one's back

examples.zh: 就是砸锅卖铁，也要供孩子上大学。
examples.en: Even if we have to sell everything we own, we'll put the child through university.

examples.zh: 他砸锅卖铁凑了一笔钱开了这家店。
examples.en: He scraped together every penny he had to open the shop.

usage.en: Predicate; often 就是/哪怕砸锅卖铁也要…….
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“砸锅卖铁也要……”。

meaning.en: With ample virtue one can bear all things, as the earth supports everything on it; a motto of tolerance and moral strength.
meaning.zh: 以深厚的德行容载万物，指道德高尚的人能包容一切。

examples.zh: “自强不息，厚德载物”是清华大学的校训。
examples.en: 'Strive constantly; with ample virtue bear all things' is Tsinghua University's motto.

examples.zh: 做人要厚德载物，宽以待人。
examples.en: A person should be morally generous and tolerant of others.

story.en: The commentary on the Kun (Earth) hexagram: as the earth is broad and receptive, the gentleman 'carries all things with ample virtue' (君子以厚德载物).
story.zh: 《周易·坤·象》：“地势坤，君子以厚德载物。”

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.en: Predicate or used as a motto; often paired with 自强不息.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或格言，常与“自强不息”连用。

meaning.en: Having vast magical powers (Buddhist term); now, being extraordinarily resourceful or well connected.
meaning.zh: 原指佛法的神奇力量广大无边，现形容本领高超、办法多。

examples.zh: 孙悟空神通广大，会七十二变。
examples.en: The Monkey King has amazing powers and can transform 72 ways.

examples.zh: 他神通广大，演唱会的门票都能弄到。
examples.en: He's so resourceful he can even get tickets to the concert.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，有时含讽刺。

meaning.en: Strong winds and high waves; figuratively, great upheavals and hardships in life or society.
meaning.zh: 大的风浪，比喻社会的大动荡或人生的大风险、大挫折。

examples.zh: 他是见过大风大浪的人，这点小事吓不倒他。
examples.en: He's weathered great storms; something this small won't scare him.

examples.zh: 公司经历过多次大风大浪，依然屹立不倒。
examples.en: The company has come through many upheavals and is still standing.

usage.en: Object; often 见过/经历过大风大浪.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“见过大风大浪”。

meaning.en: A thin stream flows long: use resources sparingly so they last; or keep doing something steadily over time.
meaning.zh: 比喻节约使用财物，使经常不缺用；也比喻一点一滴不间断地做某件事。

examples.zh: 工资不多，得细水长流地花。
examples.en: My salary isn't much, so I have to make it last.

examples.zh: 学外语要细水长流，每天坚持一点。
examples.en: Learning a language is about steady effort, a little every day.

examples.zh: 感情也需要细水长流的经营。
examples.en: Relationships need steady, long-term care.

antonyms: 沙锅里捣蒜——一锤子买卖

meaning.en: Joy shows on one's eyebrows; visibly delighted.
meaning.zh: 喜悦的心情从眉眼上表现出来。

examples.zh: 听说儿子考上了大学，老两口喜上眉梢。
examples.en: Hearing their son had got into university, the old couple were beaming.

examples.zh: 拿到年终奖，大家都喜上眉梢。
examples.en: Everyone was all smiles when the year-end bonus arrived.

meaning.en: To understand something thoroughly; to have a clear picture in one's mind.
meaning.zh: 心里非常清楚明白。

examples.zh: 对这个项目的每个环节，他都了然于胸。
examples.en: He knows every stage of the project inside out.

examples.zh: 考前把知识点梳理一遍，做到了然于胸。
examples.en: Go over the key points before the exam so you have them clear in your mind.

usage.en: Predicate; often 做到了然于胸.

meaning.en: So changed in behaviour or appearance as to seem a different person.
meaning.zh: 前后言行或样子差别很大，像两个人一样。

examples.zh: 他戒酒以后跟以前判若两人。
examples.en: Since giving up drink, he's like a different person.

examples.zh: 她在台上和台下判若两人。
examples.en: On stage and off, she's two completely different people.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“与……判若两人”。

meaning.en: Ironically, 'close the doors — good luck!': a business going bust or closing down.
meaning.zh: 商店倒闭或企业停业的戏谑说法。

examples.zh: 那家餐馆开了不到半年就关门大吉了。
examples.en: That restaurant went bust in under six months.

examples.zh: 再不改进服务，迟早关门大吉。
examples.en: Without better service, the shop will close down sooner or later.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，含诙谐、讽刺意味。

meaning.en: Anger flaring ten metres high; furious.
meaning.zh: 怒火上升三丈高，形容非常生气。

examples.zh: 看到孩子又在打游戏，爸爸火冒三丈。
examples.en: Seeing the kid gaming again, Dad hit the roof.

examples.zh: 裁判的误判让主教练火冒三丈。
examples.en: The referee's bad call made the manager furious.

meaning.en: To act recklessly and do whatever wrong one pleases.
meaning.zh: 不顾法纪或舆论，任意胡来。

examples.zh: 决不允许黑恶势力胡作非为。
examples.en: Criminal gangs will never be allowed to run amok.

examples.zh: 仗着父亲有权，他到处胡作非为。
examples.en: Relying on his father's power, he did whatever he liked.

antonyms: 非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动

meaning.en: Talk in the streets and alleys; public gossip and opinion.
meaning.zh: 大街小巷里人们的议论。

examples.zh: 这起案件成了街谈巷议的话题。
examples.en: The case became the talk of the town.

examples.zh: 街谈巷议不可全信。
examples.en: You can't believe all the street gossip.

meaning.en: Past the age of seventy (古稀, from Du Fu's 'Few have lived to seventy since ancient times').
meaning.zh: 年纪超过七十岁。

examples.zh: 老人年逾古稀，依然坚持每天写字。
examples.en: Though over seventy, the old man still practises calligraphy every day.

examples.zh: 这位年逾古稀的教授仍在指导研究生。
examples.en: The professor, now past seventy, still supervises postgraduates.

meaning.en: Driving a wicker cart in rags to clear the wilderness; the hardships of pioneers starting from nothing.
meaning.zh: 驾着柴车，穿着破衣去开辟山林，形容创业的艰辛。

examples.zh: 前辈们筚路蓝缕，才有了今天的成就。
examples.en: Today's achievements rest on the pioneering hardships of those before us.

examples.zh: 创业初期，他们筚路蓝缕，克服了重重困难。
examples.en: In the early days they built from scratch and overcame many difficulties.

story.en: Recalling how the early kings of Chu 'rode wicker carts in ragged clothes to open up the mountain forests' (筚路蓝缕，以启山林).
story.zh: 《左传·宣公十二年》：“筚路蓝缕，以启山林。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also written 荜路蓝缕.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。也作“荜路蓝缕”。

meaning.en: To make decisions on one's own without consulting others.
meaning.zh: 不经请示或商量，自己拿主意。

equivalents: take matters into one's own hands

examples.zh: 这件事你怎么能自作主张呢？
examples.en: How could you decide this without asking anyone?

examples.zh: 她自作主张把房子租出去了。
examples.en: She went ahead and let out the flat without consulting anyone.

meaning.en: A minor sorcerer meeting a great one; something that pales into insignificance beside something much greater.
meaning.zh: 小巫师见到大巫师，法术无法施展，比喻相形之下，一个远远比不上另一个。

equivalents: small fry next to the big fish

examples.zh: 跟他的收藏比起来，我这些不过是小巫见大巫。
examples.en: Compared to his collection, mine is nothing.

examples.zh: 这点堵车跟北京比，真是小巫见大巫。
examples.en: This traffic is nothing compared to Beijing's.

usage.en: Predicate; often 跟……比，……是小巫见大巫.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“跟……比，真是小巫见大巫”。

story.en: Chen Lin, replying to Zhang Hong, wrote that when a small shaman meets a great one, his spirit is exhausted (小巫见大巫，神气尽矣). The letter is preserved in Pei Songzhi's commentary to the Wu Shu biography of Zhang Hong.
story.zh: 陈琳《答张纮书》：“小巫见大巫，神气尽矣。”此书载于《三国志·吴书·张纮传》裴松之注。

meaning.en: To swindle, cheat, abduct and defraud; all kinds of dishonest dealings.
meaning.zh: 坑害、蒙骗、拐带、诈骗等各种不正当行为。

examples.zh: 这伙人专门坑蒙拐骗外地游客。
examples.en: This gang specialises in conning tourists.

examples.zh: 做生意要讲诚信，不能坑蒙拐骗。
examples.en: Business requires honesty, not swindling.

meaning.en: Too high to climb; unattainable, or (of a person) aloof and unapproachable.
meaning.zh: 高得无法攀登，比喻难以达到，或人高傲难以接近。

examples.zh: 对普通家庭来说，这里的房价高不可攀。
examples.en: For ordinary families, house prices here are out of reach.

examples.zh: 别把科学看成高不可攀的东西。
examples.en: Don't see science as something unattainable.

examples.zh: 她虽然是明星，却一点也不高不可攀。
examples.en: Though a star, she's not at all unapproachable.

meaning.en: Having had plenty to eat and drink.
meaning.zh: 酒也喝够了，饭也吃饱了。

examples.zh: 酒足饭饱之后，大家开始唱歌。
examples.en: After a hearty meal everyone started singing.

examples.zh: 客人们酒足饭饱，满意地离开了。
examples.en: The guests left well fed and satisfied.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 酒足饭饱之后.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“酒足饭饱之后”。

meaning.en: To click one's tongue in admiration; to praise enthusiastically.
meaning.zh: 咂着嘴连声称赞。

examples.zh: 看了他的作品，评委们啧啧称赞。
examples.en: The judges were full of praise for his work.

examples.zh: 这道菜让外国客人啧啧称赞。
examples.en: The foreign guests raved about this dish.

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人/让人啧啧称赞.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人啧啧称赞”。

meaning.en: So angry one cannot contain oneself.
meaning.zh: 愤怒得难以抑制。

examples.zh: 看到虐待动物的视频，网友们怒不可遏。
examples.en: Netizens were livid after seeing the animal-cruelty video.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他怒不可遏，一拳砸在桌上。
examples.en: Hearing the news he was beside himself with rage and slammed his fist on the table.

meaning.en: Dizzy and seeing stars.
meaning.zh: 头发晕，眼发花。

examples.zh: 站起来太猛，我一阵头晕目眩。
examples.en: I stood up too fast and felt dizzy.

examples.zh: 在烈日下站了一上午，好几个学生头晕目眩。
examples.en: After a morning standing in the hot sun, several pupils felt light-headed.

meaning.en: The evening sun sinking in the west; dusk, sometimes evoking old age or decline.
meaning.zh: 傍晚太阳从西边落下，也比喻衰老或衰落。

examples.zh: 夕阳西下，渔船陆续回港。
examples.en: As the sun set, the fishing boats returned to harbour one by one.

examples.zh: 夕阳西下时，公园里散步的人多了起来。
examples.en: At sunset, more people come out to walk in the park.

story.en: Ma Zhiyuan's famous Yuan-dynasty song lyric 'Autumn Thoughts' ends: 'The evening sun sinks in the west; a heartbroken man at the edge of the world.'
story.zh: 马致远《天净沙·秋思》：“夕阳西下，断肠人在天涯。”

usage.zh: 多单独成句，作时间状语。
